findings.title: `unsubscribe` dereferences a `TopicUser` that may be nil
findings.description: `tu = TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` can return nil when the user has no `TopicUser` row for the topic. The next line, `tu.notification_level`, then raises `NoMethodError` and returns a 500. Use `find_or_initialize_by` or handle the nil case explicitly.

findings.title: Triple-stash renders the translated string as unescaped HTML
findings.description: `{{{stopNotificiationsText}}}` outputs raw HTML. The text interpolates `model.fancyTitle` through `I18n.t`, so a topic title containing markup would be rendered unescaped. Use the double-stash form, or confirm that `fancyTitle` is already sanitized and document that assumption.

findings.title: Template path does not match the route name
findings.description: The route is registered as top-level `this.route('topicUnsubscribe', ...)`. In Ember this resolves to a template named `topic-unsubscribe`, but the template was added as `templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs`, which is the nested `topic.unsubscribe` form. The page may render with no template. Rename the template or the route to match.

findings.title: Misspelled computed property name
findings.description: `stopNotificiationsText` misspells "Notifications". The template uses the same misspelling, so the code works, but the name will spread if it is copied elsewhere. Rename it to `stopNotificationsText` in both files.

findings.title: Unverified references in the new route and mailer
findings.description: The route calls `PostStream.loadTopicView` and `topic.updateFromJson`, and `afterModel` calls `topic.set("details.notificationReasonText", null)`, which throws if `details` is undefined on a freshly created record. The controller also calls `perform_show_response` and `slugs_do_not_match`. I could not confirm that these exist. Separately, `unsubscribe_url` is now passed to the mailer, but the `unsubscribe_link` i18n string must reference `%{unsubscribe_url}` for the link to render. Confirm all of these.

structured_findings.summary: `unsubscribe` dereferences a `TopicUser` that may be nil
Triple-stash renders the translated string as unescaped HTML
Template path does not match the route name
Unverified references in the new route and mailer
